name: Castletown Hotel
accommodation: 24 en-suite single, double, twin and family rooms
beachAccess: In Castletown at the curve of Dunnet Bay

overview: The Castletown Hotel is in Castletown, at the curve of Dunnet Bay between Thurso and John O'Groats. It has 24 en-suite rooms, from singles to family rooms, plus a restaurant, public bar and residents' lounge. Parking is free.
surfTripFit: It sits at the western end of the bay, giving quick access to Dunnet and Thurso's breaks.
